title: X2Go Client Set-Up
author: Laurel Dieckhaus
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.62whgfe
materials: Type engr-hutchin02g.catnet.arizona.edu in the Host text box.
Select MATE for the Session Type .

steps.title: Install X2Go Client
steps.instruction: Download and install the X2Go Client from https://wiki.x2go.org/doku.php, selecting the installer compatible with your computer's operating system (e.g., Windows Installer for Windows).

steps.title: Create New Session
steps.instruction: Launch the X2Go Client and initiate a new session configuration.

substeps.instruction: Select 'Session' in the upper left corner
Select 'New Session' from the drop-down menu

steps.title: Configure Session Parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the required session preferences in the new window.

substeps.instruction: Enter your University of Arizona username in the 'Login' text box
Set 'Connection Speed' to 'WAN' if on campus using the Linux box, or 'ADSL' if working from home
Set 'Display' to 'Custom' with a width and height of 1600x900

steps.title: Configure Media and Folders
steps.instruction: Adjust the Media and Shared Folders settings.

substeps.instruction: Select the 'Media' tab and match settings to the provided reference
Optionally modify the 'Shared Folders' tab to include a local desktop folder for data collection or protocols

steps.title: Launch and Authenticate Session
steps.instruction: Start the session and log in to the system.

substeps.instruction: Click on the finalized session in the right column of the X2Go window
Enter your password in the login dialog box and press enter
